artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2019 and 2020, GE continues to emphasize artificial_intelligence and supply_chain as core risk exposure (2019 para 21; 2020 para 19). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in artificial_intelligence, while the later filing adds clearer weight to supply_chain (2019 para 7; 2020 para 8). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2019 para 21; 2020 para 8). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2019 para 7; 2020 para 19). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2019 para 21; 2020 para 19).
